{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies .github/workflows/ci.yml and ci/test scripts to drop privileged container mode and remove BCC dependencies in ASan CI.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Dropping privileged container execution in ASan CI improves runner security and removes the BCC toolchain dependency. The change resolves a stated CI goal ('The ASan CI job no longer needs a privileged container and uses SYS_PTRACE instead'), though it remains secondary to the test framework rework."
    },
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches doc/tracing.md (+18/-0) solely to reflect the new test running requirements.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Documentation updates in doc/tracing.md merely follow the test framework changes and do not constitute a primary documentation change."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Rewrites USDT functional test framework (test/functional/test_framework/usdt.py) and five USDT tests to run under GDB instead of BCC/eBPF.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Replacing BCC with GDB removes embedded BPF programs and kernel header dependencies, enabling USDT tests to run locally without root permissions. As noted in the description, this removes 'roughly 660 lines of test and CI code' and reduces ongoing maintenance burden."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 0,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
